_meta.status: TARGET BEHAVIOR (draft for review). These cases describe where Taskbean should go, not what it does today. Failures are the expected gap, not regressions.
_meta.model: Taskbean reconciles outcomes with execution evidence for attribution, AI-value evidence, standups and leadership reports. Planner/To Do own commitments, owners, dates and assignments. Durable Priorities owns strategic outcomes. Copilot sessions and plan mode are execution evidence, not durable task storage.

fields.input: What the user, agent or host does.
fields.check: Name of the automated check in checks.mjs, or null.
fields.method: runtime = runs the CLI/canvas in an isolated sandbox; static = proxy check on shipped text/manifest; none = not yet testable.
fields.current: Recorded result for the current code: pass, fail or not_testable. The runner reports drift when the measured result differs.

cases.title: Several asks that serve one result become one outcome
cases.input: User: "Update the README with the new endpoints, add validation to POST /users, and write tests for the validation."
cases.expected: One outcome (for example "Validate POST /users input") with README, code and test changes attached as evidence. No separate task per ask.

cases.title: Retries, CI reruns and commands are evidence, not tasks
cases.input: Agent fixes a flaky test, reruns CI three times and runs lint between runs.
cases.expected: One outcome. Reruns, commands and sub-steps are provenance on that outcome. Guidance names commands/retries/branches as evidence.

cases.title: Retried capture with the same key does not duplicate
cases.input: Capture the same outcome twice with the same stable key (retry after a crash).
cases.expected: One outcome remains; the second capture updates it.

cases.title: Same work across a new worktree stays one unit
cases.input: Outcome captured in worktree A with key K; work continues in worktree B of the same repository with key K.
cases.expected: One human-facing outcome with both worktrees as provenance.
cases.open_question: Which identity joins worktrees: repository + key, an explicit outcome id, or #57 Project identity?

cases.title: Completion needs outcome evidence, not only agent activity
cases.input: Agent runs `bean done <id>` with no evidence after a turn ends.
cases.expected: Outcome is not reported as delivered without evidence; it is marked done-without-evidence or held for review.
cases.open_question: Should user-directed corrections still allow done without evidence?

cases.title: Planning and commitment requests do not trigger Taskbean
cases.input: User: "Plan my week and add the SSO launch to my to-do list."
cases.expected: No Taskbean write. Guidance points commitments to Planner/To Do.

cases.title: Plan-mode todo lists are not stored as tasks
cases.input: Agent produces an 8-step plan in plan mode.
cases.expected: No Taskbean tasks for plan steps. Plan mode is ephemeral execution evidence.

cases.title: Pure explanation does not trigger
cases.input: User: "Explain how the JWT middleware works."
cases.expected: No Taskbean activity.

cases.title: Small edits inside an outcome are not standalone tasks
cases.input: During an outcome, the agent fixes a typo and a lint warning.
cases.expected: Edits are evidence on the current outcome. Guidance does not tell agents to log every small fix.
cases.open_question: A standalone small fix with no surrounding outcome: record an outcome, or evidence only?

cases.title: Capture is not a mandatory pre-step for all coding work
cases.input: Any coding request.
cases.expected: The description does not require `bean add` before all coding work. Hooks capture intent; manual add/done is for corrections and exceptions.

cases.title: Manual commands are positioned as corrections
cases.input: Hooks captured the turn; the user says the title is wrong.
cases.expected: Guidance uses manual commands to correct captured records, not as the primary capture path.

cases.title: Standup and AI-value requests trigger reporting
cases.input: User: "Prepare my standup and show what AI delivered this week."
cases.expected: Taskbean report is used. The description names standups and AI-value evidence.

cases.title: Work on an existing commitment links evidence instead of creating a task
cases.input: User: "Work on my Planner task 'Ship SSO' - fix the redirect bug."
cases.expected: Evidence links to the Planner/To Do commitment reference. No competing Taskbean commitment is created.

cases.title: Owners and due dates of commitments stay in Planner/To Do
cases.input: Agent learns a deadline for a Planner commitment.
cases.expected: Taskbean does not author a competing due date or owner for that commitment.
cases.open_question: Taskbean still has due dates, reminders and `bean edit --due-date`. Keep them for personal items, or retire them?

cases.title: Taskbean never mutates Planner/To Do autonomously
cases.input: Any capture or report flow.
cases.expected: No Planner/To Do/Graph writes from the CLI or canvas.

cases.title: Session identity is attached to captured work
cases.input: Capture from a Copilot session with agent and session id.
cases.expected: Stored record carries the agent and session id.

cases.title: PRs and commits attach to an outcome as evidence
cases.input: Outcome produced PR #42 and two commits.
cases.expected: PR and commit references are stored as evidence on the outcome.

cases.title: Multiple sessions contribute to one outcome
cases.input: Session A starts outcome K; session B continues it with the same key.
cases.expected: One outcome with both sessions retained as evidence.

cases.title: Interrupted session is not a false success
cases.input: Outcome started; the session terminates without an end event or done.
cases.expected: Outcome stays incomplete, not done.

cases.title: Interrupted session shows a recoverable state
cases.input: Same as EV-04, then a new session opens in the project.
cases.expected: Outcome shows a visible recoverable/incomplete marker linked to the lost session, with no duplicate created.

cases.title: Turn start/end hooks are packaged
cases.input: Install the plugin.
cases.expected: The manifest declares start-of-turn and end-of-turn hooks (observe-only first).

cases.title: One logical turn yields one intent and one result record
cases.input: Hook events are retried and delivered out of order.
cases.expected: Exactly one intent record and one result record per turn (idempotency keys).

cases.title: Report is organized by outcomes
cases.input: `generate_report` for a week with work.
cases.expected: Report JSON has outcomes, not only a task list grouped by status.

cases.title: Each reported outcome cites its evidence
cases.input: Outcome with a session and PR.
cases.expected: Report item carries an evidence list (sessions, PRs, commits).

cases.title: Blockers carry a reason and HITL state
cases.input: Agent blocks an outcome waiting on a reviewer.
cases.expected: Block records a reason and whether a human decision is needed.

cases.title: Report includes usage evidence for AI value
cases.input: `generate_report`.
cases.expected: Report includes a usage/efficiency section usable as AI-value evidence.
cases.open_question: How is "AI value" defined beyond token/session counts?

cases.title: Pending reconciliation suggestions are not completed work
cases.input: Weekly report with pending Chronicle suggestions.
cases.expected: Pending suggestions are review-only, not counted as done.

cases.title: No raw prompt, response or tool-output columns
cases.input: Inspect the Taskbean database schema after capture.
cases.expected: No column stores raw prompts, responses or tool output.

cases.title: Credentials in the environment are not stored
cases.input: Capture while GH_TOKEN and similar variables are set.
cases.expected: No credential value appears in the database.

cases.title: Agent-invoked canvas changes need confirmation
cases.input: Agent invokes add/start/block/complete on the canvas.
cases.expected: Mutation actions are approval-gated (explicit confirmation input or host approval).
cases.open_question: Action-level confirm flag, or rely on host approval? Exempt mutations the user directly asked for?

cases.title: Canvas errors redact local paths
cases.input: CLI crashes with a message that contains the home directory.
cases.expected: Error shown to the agent/user has the home directory redacted.

cases.title: Secret-looking text in a title
cases.input: Agent captures a title that contains a token-shaped string.
cases.expected: To be decided.

cases.title: Availability reports plugin and CLI versions
cases.input: `get_availability`.
cases.expected: Output includes plugin version, CLI version and compatibility status.

cases.title: Older CLI fails with an actionable version error
cases.input: Plugin 0.7.0 with CLI 0.5.2 installed.
cases.expected: Explicit version-skew error naming both versions and the upgrade step; no silent fallback.

cases.title: Unsupported Copilot host is diagnosed
cases.input: Plugin loaded by a Copilot host without canvas support.
cases.expected: Diagnostic names the host version and the missing capability.

cases.title: Shipped versions agree
cases.input: Repository at release.
cases.expected: plugin.json, both marketplaces, CLI package and skill marker share one version.

cases.title: Upgrade and uninstall keep Taskbean data
cases.input: Install, update and uninstall the plugin through Copilot.
cases.expected: Data stays; only plugin-owned files are removed.
cases.note: Covered by the opt-in live test cli/src/tests/plugin-lifecycle.test.js (TASKBEAN_TEST_COPILOT).

open_questions: Issue cross-references disagree: #113's body says #116 defines skills/triggers, #116 says #117 does. These cases treat #117 as the owner of trigger language.
Report value (#114) is out of this session's scope; RP cases only assert the minimum shape.
